name: GeM (Government e-Marketplace)
description: Online platform for procurement of goods and services by government buyers and selling by sellers/MSMEs.
benefits: Transparent public procurement, direct market access, MSE preference, timely payment.
eligibility: Sellers (including MSMEs) and government buyers; sellers need business registration, bank, tax details.
fees: No fee for buyers; sellers pay one-time caution money + per-transaction charges per GeM policy.
processing_time: Registration quick; transaction per bid cycle.
